iterations: Initial Tanu ear roots required an actual inward translation; horn/spine and expanded-belt witness points needed interior overlap points. Original diagnostics and source revisions remain archived.

Native views exposed discontinuous body paint across closed chest volumes, an obscured Tanu forehead and chest, and a floating rear belt loop. Data-owned paint projection, an open hood/veil, revised belly and fitted belt correct these observations.

Initial Halahaches pose18 capture preceded its queued VIEW event. The fixture now verifies the requested pose index with longer barriers, and checks VIEW -> indexed PASS -> screenshot ordering for all23 frames. The first ordering parser selected Prepare pose0 instead of the capture pose0; the corrected parser locates events relative to each screenshot. Both diagnostic failures remain evidence.

Rear native review exposed Halahaches hair buried in the upper back and reappearing below. Existing continuous locks curve behind the torso with unchanged roots. Final Halahaches continuity/art and all action tests are repeated; byte equality bounds reuse for four unaffected species.
The initial repeat-export check expected18files although both exports contained19 identical files. The check now enumerates the exact expected set and rejects extra files in either output.
reviewed: Final-art front/profile/rear, face/horn/hair/cloth details, extreme stride, attack, pain, intermediate death and oblique lying poses; both final-package presentation scenes per species. Reviewed iteration reuse is bounded by reuse01.json.
qualifications: Stylized closed component anatomy, painted face detail, opaque hair and rigid fall/rest poses remain candidates. Fixed clothes do not add modular equipped inventory.

All unchanged native actor scale/collision, stats, combat, loot, identity and save fields remain authoritative. Reference metre dimensions, powers and campaign placements are not adopted. Wide silhouettes may exceed provisional collision.
